notes.title: Patch v0.9.1 is now online
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

Vinnie's Diary patch v0.9.1 is now online.

Thanks to the contribution of community.  We made following modifications in this patch:
1. Now players can choose whether to use a free-look camera or a Vinnie's Diary style camera. 
2. Bug fixed. Players may not be stuck in chapter 3 now.

We are still working on this game and trying to bring the best gaming experience to you!
